title: Midnight at Pier 9
setting: Pier 9, Red Hook, Brooklyn, on a foggy night
blurb: Fog off the harbor. A union boss in a warehouse. And a paper trail somebody wanted sunk.
victim: Union boss Tommy Kane was killed with a cargo hook in the Pier 9 warehouse tonight at about midnight and found at 12:30 am.

intro: The fog rolled in off the harbor thick enough to drown in, the night Tommy Kane went down.

At half past midnight they found him in the Pier 9 warehouse, slumped between the cargo bays, a longshoreman's hook beside him. The man who ran every dock from Red Hook to the Navy Yard, killed with a tool of his own trade.
The pier gates were chained at eleven. Five people were still on Pier 9 when the fog came down.
narration.detectiveEnters: And then you came up the gangway, detective. No union card, no debts on the waterfront. Find out who sank Tommy Kane.

rooms.name: The Warehouse
rooms.description: Cargo bays, hanging hooks, and the chalk outline of a union boss.

rooms.name: Harbor Office
rooms.description: Filing cabinets, a telephone, and stacks of shipping manifests.

rooms.name: The Pier
rooms.description: Wet planks, coiled rope, and a freighter riding low at its moorings.

rooms.name: Seamen's Chapel
rooms.description: A tiny waterfront chapel, candles burning, and a donation box that's always full.

suspects.name: Maria Costa
suspects.story: Maria Costa. The dock clerk. Polite, tireless, always with a pencil behind her ear and a cup of coffee for the men. Nobody on Pier 9 has a bad word to say about her.

suspects.name: Capt. Erik Haugen
suspects.story: Captain Erik Haugen. Master of the Norwegian freighter Nordlys. Thirty years at sea, and a cargo hold that always seems heavier than its paperwork.
suspects.voice: gruff, blunt, Norwegian accent, few words

suspects.name: Big Paulie Grasso
suspects.story: Big Paulie Grasso. Kane's foreman and his fists. Six and a half feet of muscle, and everyone on the docks knows he's been waiting for the big chair.
suspects.voice: loud, blunt, menacing, not very bright

suspects.name: Father Anselm
suspects.story: Father Anselm. Priest of the Seamen's Chapel, confessor to sinners and longshoremen alike. Tommy Kane's donations kept his candles burning.
suspects.voice: gentle, measured, quotes scripture, careful with words

suspects.name: Jack Kane
suspects.story: Jack Kane. Tommy's only son, twenty-two and angry at the world. Tonight half the pier heard him shouting at his father.
suspects.voice: young, bitter, defiant, grief hidden under anger
